_about: Source for translating PhotoAgent into another language. Keys are the Chinese the code uses; a new catalog is keyed the same way.
Translate `en_full` when an entry has it, `en` otherwise. `en_full` and `note` mark English that was shortened for the layout, or that stands for several Chinese texts with different meanings.
`where`: panel = frontend/i18n-en.js, chat = frontend-chat/src/i18n/en.ts, backend = photo_agent/i18n_en.py (labels = LABELS, text = TEXT). When the catalogs disagree, `en` holds each one's English.
A key ending in @@something is the same Chinese used for a different meaning; the part after @@ says which and is not shown.
Keep {placeholders}, quotes and leading/trailing spaces as they are: the page joins pieces.
Not in this file and written by hand for each language: FORMAT and PATTERNS in photo_agent/i18n_en.py (punctuation, and the regular expressions that read the AI's replies).
The Localization Hub reads ARB files with English ids (i18n/arb-keys.json), made from this file by scripts/l10n_doc.py push.
Refresh with `python scripts/translation_source.py`; hand-written fields are kept.

平衡.note: Analysis heading for the photo's visual balance in composition, not white balance.

廣角.note: Framing option: a very wide shot showing even more surroundings than a wide shot.

建立帳號失敗，請再試一次。.en: Couldn't create the account. Please try again.

建築.note: Photo category tag for architecture/buildings photos.

強勢.note: Pose style option: a strong, confident, assertive pose.

強化產品形狀、材質、色準與背景秩序。.en: Enhances the product's shape, materials and color accuracy, with a clean, orderly background.

待美化.note: Status badge on a photo: analyzed but not yet retouched.

待美化的照片.note: The photo that will be retouched.

待解決.note: Status of a submitted bug report: read but not resolved yet (not the verb 'open').

後端處理伺服器已更新，執行中的工作可能已中斷，請立即重新整理頁面。.en: The processing server has been updated, and any work in progress may have stopped. Please refresh the page now.

從原圖美化.note: Button: retouch from the original photo instead of the latest version.

從第 {n} 版美化.note: Caption under a request in the chat history: this retouch was made on top of version {n} (past, descriptive).

想再怎麼修這幾張？.en: What else would you like changed?

想再怎麼修這幾張？會套用到每一張.en: What else would you like changed? It applies to each one

想再調整，直接打字告訴我，或按{btn}的{settings}，會套用到每一張；.en: To adjust further, just tell me, or tap {settings} {btn}; changes apply to every photo. {again}

想加個風格的話，先挑類別再選；下一版會照你的需求改，再加上這裡選的風格。.en: To add a style, choose a category and then a style. The next version will follow your requests and add the style you pick here.

想只調整其中一位，點輸入框上方的頭像。.en: To adjust just one person, tap their face above the text box.

想怎麼美化這幾張？.en: How would you like these retouched?

想怎麼美化這幾張？會套用到每一張.en: How would you like these retouched? Your request applies to each photo

想怎麼美化這張照片？.en: How would you like this photo retouched?

想怎麼美化這張照片？也可以留空直接開始.en: How would you like this photo retouched? Or leave this blank to start right away

想怎麼美化這張照片？點頭像可以指定要改誰.en: How would you like this photo retouched? Tap a face to choose who

想怎麼美化？留空也可以直接開始.en: How should I retouch it? Or leave blank to start

想怎麼美化？點頭像可以指定人.en: How should I retouch it? Tap a face to choose someone

想怎麼調整這位？.en: How would you like this person adjusted?

想怎麼調整這幾位？.en: How would you like these people adjusted?

想換一種氛圍的話，先挑想改的類別再選風格；不選就維持照片原本的樣子。.en: For a different mood, choose a category and then a style. Leave it blank to keep the photo's original look.

想改的地方可以一句一句打在下面，我會先幫你看過、記下來；也可以按「風格」換光線、.en: Type what you'd like changed below, one thing at a time, and I'll check each one and note it down. You can also tap “Style” to change things like lighting or angle. Tap “Retouch from Version {n}” when you're ready.

想照第 {n} 版當初的做法再做一版，按「再美化」。.en: To make Version {n} again the way it was made, tap “Retouch Again”.

想照這樣重新產生一版，可以按「再美化」。.en: To make a new version with these settings, tap “Retouch Again”.

想看哪張的結果，從{where}選取那張。.en: To see a result, select the photo {where}.

想看哪張的結果，點上面那張。.en: To see a result, tap the photo above.

想看整張照片還有哪些地方可以修，也可以按「幫我分析」。.en: To see what else in the photo could be improved, tap “Analyze for Me”.

想調整什麼？.en: What would you like to change?

想調整什麼？點頭像可以指定要改誰.en: What would you like to change? Tap a face to choose who

想調整什麼？點頭像指定人.en: What would you like to change? Tap a face to choose

想調整哪一項點下面，改好按「{goLabel}」我就開始。.en: Tap an item below to adjust it. When you're ready, tap “{goLabel}” to start.

想調整美化項目，按「看美化項目」；想用一樣的設定再產生一版，按「再美化」。也可以.en: To adjust the edits, tap “Review Edits”. To create another version with the same settings, tap “Retouch Again”. Or just type what you'd like.

想調整美化項目，按「看美化項目」；想用一樣的設定再產生一版，按「再美化」；想接續.en: To change the enhancements, tap "Review Edits"; for another version with the same settings, tap "Retouch Again"; to build on a finished version, switch “Original” above the message box to that version. You can also just type to me.

想調整美化項目，按「看美化項目」；想直接開始美化，按「{goLabel}」。.en: To adjust the edits, tap “Review Edits”. To retouch right away, tap “{goLabel}”.

我不太確定要怎麼調整，可以直接在面板上修改。.en: I'm not sure how to make that change, but you can adjust it directly in the panels.

我理解你是想「{revised}」，已整理到個人化需求。.en: Got it, you'd like “{revised}”. I've added that to My Requests.

所有人物.note: Fills a slot naming who a portrait fix applies to: all people in the photo.

手機.note: Hint under the 3:4 aspect-ratio option: the typical phone photo shape; keep very short.

打不開這筆回報：可能沒有管理者權限，或回報已經刪掉了。.en: Couldn't open this report. You may not have admin access, or the report has been deleted.

打包下載失敗，請稍後再試。.en: Couldn't prepare the download. Please try again later.

打包中.note: Download button state: the photos are being packed into a ZIP file.

打包中….en_full: Packing the photos into a zip…

打字回答，或點上面的選項.en: Type or tap an option above

打開「{name}」.note: Fragment completing 'OK, …': the retouching switch {name} was turned on.

打開另一張.note: Action of opening another photo's session; also quoted in a warning about losing unsent photos.

打開回報.note: Action quoted in a warning: opening a submitted problem report, which clears unsent photos.

找不到這張照片的處理紀錄。.en: Couldn't find the history for this photo.

拖動調整照片和對話的大小.en: Drag to resize the photo and chat

拖曳比較修圖前後.en: Drag to compare before and after

指定{v1}.note: Tooltip on a face: aim the typed request at {v1}, a person's name.

指定人物尚未確認，請重新指定或清除該需求。.en: The selected person isn't confirmed. Please choose again or clear the request.

指定人物的名稱不可用，請重新指定。.en: The selected person's name isn't available. Please choose again.

指定人物的引用資料無效，請重新指定。.en: The selected person's reference is invalid. Please choose again.

指定人物的預覽與此照片不符，請重新指定。.en: The selected person's preview doesn't match this photo. Please choose again.

指定字樣.note: Setting name: exact text the user wants written into the photo.

指定對象.note: Button and panel for choosing which people in the photo a typed request applies to.

指定文字未通過逐字核對，或有額外新增文案，請人工複查。.en: The requested text failed the character-by-character check, or extra text was added. Please review it manually.

指定比例{ratio}需重新構圖，若需取消請把長寬比改成「原圖比例」.en: The {ratio} ratio requires reframing. To undo it, set the aspect ratio back to “Original”.

指定的人物未完成身份確認，請重新指定或清除該需求。.en: The selected person hasn't been confirmed. Please choose again or clear the request.

指定的人物未納入本次分析，請重新確認需求。.en: The selected person isn't part of this analysis. Please confirm the request again.

按{btn}的{render}會把還沒美化的都美化好；只想先看分析，按{btn}.en: Tap {render} {btn} to retouch every photo that isn't retouched yet, or {analyze} to see the analysis first.

按「從原圖美化」會從原圖重做一版，這裡的需求會一起套用，要調整的話可以先編輯。.en: Tapping “Retouch from Original” makes a new version from the original photo with all the requests here; edit them first if you want changes.

按上面的「全部一鍵美化」會把還沒美化的都美化好；只想先看分析，按上面的「全部分析.en: “Retouch All” above retouches every photo that hasn't been retouched yet. To see the analysis first, tap “Analyze All”.

按下面的按鈕就會用新構圖美化。.en: Tap the button below to retouch with the new framing.

排定的美化也先取消了。.en: The scheduled retouch was also canceled.

接續第 {n} 版美化.note: Button that starts retouching on top of version {n} (an action to tap).

接著是這張照片的美化建議：.en: Next, here are my suggestions for enhancing this photo:

接著調整.note: Label on a result: made by further adjusting the previous version (not an in-progress status).

接著這張調整.note: Button to keep editing, starting from this retouched version of the photo.

控制背景干擾並保留自然質感。.en: Minimize background distractions while keeping a natural texture.

提升主體的清晰度與立體感.en: Adding clarity and depth to the subject

提醒：{v1}.note: Prefix for a warning or reminder message shown to the user.

提醒：{warning}.note: Prefix for a warning or reminder message shown to the user.

提醒：{w}.note: Prefix for a warning or reminder message shown to the user.

換一種拍法，重新詮釋照片氛圍.en: Try a different shot to reimagine the photo's mood

換分析引擎必須重新分析這張照片，目前的分析結果和建議都會被取代。要繼續嗎？.en: Changing the analysis engine requires reanalyzing this photo, which will replace the current analysis and suggestions. Continue?

換回原圖.note: Choice to base further edits on the original photo instead of a retouched version.

換成總覽的.note: Confirm button: replace each photo's own settings with the batch overview's settings.

換成這張照片的話，剛剛打的需求和選的設定都會清掉。確定要換嗎？.en: Switching to this photo clears the requests you typed and the settings you chose. Switch anyway?

換長寬比會馬上依新的長寬比重新構圖，畫面建議裡的構圖也會跟著換。.en: Changing the aspect ratio reframes the photo immediately and updates the framing in the scene suggestions.

收整腰腹外緣，讓衣著側線更貼合.en: Tidy the waist edge so the garment's side line fits more closely

改善亮度層次與主體分離，避免過曝、死黑或平面化。.en: Improve tonal depth and subject separation while avoiding blown highlights, crushed shadows or a flat look.

改好了按{btn}的{redo}重新美化。.en: When you're ready, tap {redo} {btn} to retouch them again.

改好了按{btn}的{redo}重新美化；沒改直接按，會照原本的需求和設定再美化.en: When you're ready, tap {redo} {btn} to retouch them again. If nothing has changed, they'll be retouched with the same requests and settings, and the results may differ a little from last time.

改好後按下面的「美化」我就開始.en: When you're ready, tap “Retouch” below to start
改好後按下面的「美化」我就開始.note: Wording variant; same meaning as the other texts with this English.

改好後按下面的「美化」我就開始。.en: When you're ready, tap “Retouch” below to start.

改變長寬比需要依新比例重新構圖，會再呼叫一次分析模型並產生額外費用；畫面建議的其.en: Changing the aspect ratio reframes the photo, which runs the analysis model again at an additional cost. Other scene suggestions stay the same. Continue?

整理光線、色彩與構圖的改善建議.en: Compiling lighting, color and composition improvements

整體美化.note: Option to retouch everything the AI suggests plus the user's requests, versus requests only.

方.note: Photo orientation, next to 橫 and 直.

方形.note: Aspect-ratio option for a square (1:1) frame shape.

日常.note: Scene category tag for everyday, daily-life photos.

暖陽.note: Name of a warm orange colour theme for the app UI, not a lighting setting.

更換.note: Confirm button: replace the current choice with the new one.

更新回報狀態失敗：HTTP {status}.en: Couldn't update the report status: HTTP {status}

最多只能選 {MAX_BATCH} 張，先加前 {length} 張。.en: You can choose up to {MAX_BATCH}, so only the first {length} were added.

最後是設定，可以改美化時用的引擎和輸出尺寸。要看一下嗎？.en: Finally, settings: you can change the engine and output size. Want to take a look?

最後是風格，{names}可以換一種氛圍，不選就維持照片原本的樣子。要看看嗎？.en: Finally, style: {names} can give the photo a different mood. Leave them blank to keep its original look. Want to take a look?

有 {n} 張開始分析了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，從{where}選.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being analyzed. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, select it {where}.

有 {n} 張開始分析了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，點上面那張。.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being analyzed. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, tap it above.

有 {n} 張開始美化了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，從{where}選.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being retouched. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, select it {where}.

有 {n} 張開始美化了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，點上面那張。.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being retouched. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, tap it above.

有 {n} 張開始處理了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，從{where}選.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being processed. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, select it {where}.

有 {n} 張開始處理了，完成後我會在這裡說；想看哪張的進度，點上面那張。.en: {n} {n, plural, =1{photo is} other{photos are}} now being processed. I'll let you know here when they're done. To check a photo's progress, tap it above.

有 {v1} 個檔案不是圖片，先略過。.en: {v1} {v1, plural, =1{file isn't an image and was} other{files aren't images and were}} skipped.

有小圓點的是看過原圖後建議調整的項目，點一下可以開或關。.en: A dot marks a change suggested after reviewing the original. Tap an item to turn it on or off.

有幾張講了需求，要整體美化，還是僅依需求修改？在單張頁已經選過的，照它自己選的。.en: Some photos have requests. Full Retouch, or only the requested changes? Photos that already have a choice on their own page will keep it.

有幾版是接著別版調整的，其他皆由原圖重新產生.en: Some versions adjust another version; the rest are regenerated from the original

有需求.note: Status badge on a photo: the user has typed retouching requests but not started yet.

未執行.note: Shown instead of a duration when this processing step was skipped.

未定.note: Quality-check result when the check could neither confirm a pass nor flag a problem.

未指定對象.note: Heading for retouching requests not aimed at any particular person in the photo.

未讀.note: Status of a submitted bug report: not yet read by the team.

本機依 AI 建議裁切框的實際比例（{measured}）於支援清單中選出最接近.en: From the actual ratio of the AI's suggested crop ({measured}), the closest supported ratio “{label}” was chosen, and the crop was confirmed after applying the ROI and protected-area constraints.

本機依 AI 建議裁切框的實際比例（{measured}）選擇候選比例，但套用.en: A ratio was chosen from the actual ratio of the AI's suggested crop ({measured}), but the ROI and protected-area constraints expanded the crop back to the full frame, so the original ratio is kept.

本機完成 ROI／保護區域約束後確認此裁切可執行。.en: The crop was confirmed after applying the ROI and protected-area constraints.

本機將原裁切提案 fit 到此比例並完成 ROI／保護區域約束。.en: The original crop was fitted to this ratio with the ROI and protected-area constraints applied.

本機幾何解析後不需要額外構圖裁切。.en: Geometry analysis found no extra crop is needed.

本機幾何解析後沒有可執行的構圖裁切，維持完整畫面。.en: Geometry analysis found no workable crop, so the full frame is kept.

本機幾何解析後選擇完整原圖構圖，不執行裁切。.en: Geometry analysis kept the full original composition, with no crop.

本機模式只做簡易裁切與色彩增強，未執行 AI 輸出 QA。.en: Local mode only applies a basic crop and color enhancement; the AI quality check wasn't run.

本機處理.note: Shown in place of the image-model name when the photo was processed locally without AI image generation.

本機預覽.note: Quality-check status when the app ran in offline local mode, so no AI check was done.

材質.note: Short tag on the product-photo style preset: emphasises how surface materials and textures look.

柔光.note: Lighting style option: soft, diffused light (not the layer blend mode).

查看或調整這張照片使用的分析模型、美化引擎與輸出選項。分析模型變更後會重新分析，.en: View or change the analysis model, retouch engine and output options for this photo. Changing the analysis model triggers a new analysis, and changing the aspect ratio reframes the photo. Other settings apply to the next retouch.

校正白平衡與整體色溫.en: Correcting white balance and color temperature

格狀.note: Gallery layout option: show photos in an even grid.

桌布.note: Hint under the 16:9 aspect-ratio option: desktop wallpaper shape; keep very short.

梳整俐落.note: The stronger of the two hair-fix levels.

極光.note: Name of a colour theme for the app interface; keep it short.

構圖平衡穩定。.en: The composition is balanced and steady.

構圖必須完整保留。.en: Must stay whole in the composition.

模型未判定此項目需要修正，無需操作.en: The model found nothing to fix here. No action needed.

橫.note: Photo orientation, in 「Ratio 3:2 (landscape)」. Not scenery: that is 風景.

橫幅.note: Horizontal photo orientation, as in 5:4（橫幅）. Not scenery.

橫式 →.note: Right end of the aspect-ratio scale: wider, landscape-orientation shapes (not scenery).

檢視主體輪廓與周圍環境的區隔.en: Reviewing subject separation from the surroundings

檢視前景、中景與遠景的層次關係.en: Reviewing foreground, midground and background layers

檢視方式.note: Label for the switch between panel mode and chat mode (noun, the viewing mode).

檢視畫面中的視覺焦點.en_full: Looking at the photo's visual focal points

檢視背景細節對主體的影響.en: Reviewing how background details affect the subject

檢視重要細節是否受到邊緣裁切影響.en: Checking whether key details are cut off at the edges

歡呼.note: Pose style option: cheering pose with arms raised.

正在分析整張照片，完成後建議會顯示在這裡。.en: Analyzing the whole photo. Suggestions will appear here when it's done.

正在初步辨識照片中的人物。.en: Detecting the people in the photo…

正在判斷照片類型與拍攝場景….en: Determining the photo type and scene…

正在對照第 {from} 版，整理這版的變化….en: Comparing with version {from} to describe what changed…

正在規劃成品的光影與色調方向….en: Planning the lighting and color direction…

此比例下維持完整原圖（沒有有效裁切）.en: keeps the full original at this ratio (no effective crop)

此項目已在人像修正設定中關閉，需先在設定中開啟才能個別調整.en: This is turned off in Portrait Fix Settings. Turn it on there first to adjust it per person.
